.boot — disconnect a session (staff)

  .boot <name>            drop them, no reason given
  .boot <name> <reason>   drop them and say why

The account is untouched: they can reconnect at once. This is for a stuck
or abusive session, and it is also the fix for "already connected" when a
ghost session holds a name. Their usual logout line is shown to the world,
so a boot reads like any other departure. Logged as a fact.

To keep someone OUT rather than merely off, use .ban.
